issues.legal_issue: The depreciation basis for an asset allotted to a member of a divided Hindu joint family is its genuine value at partition, including where the member acquired the asset through a family auction.
material_facts: A Hindu joint family was divided, and an asset that could not be physically divided was put up for competitive bidding between the branches.
The appellant’s branch acquired the factory after its bid was accepted, and the bid value was used in the partition accounts.
The valuation was real rather than notional, and the factory was sold in an open auction between the family members.
The appellant claimed depreciation using the auction valuation; the Tribunal and High Court instead treated the appellant’s pre-existing share by reference to the larger family’s original cost.
issues.conclusion: Depreciation was to be computed using the genuine valuation at which the appellant took over the asset, including for the appellant’s own share.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 10(2)(vi) and 10(5) of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922, depreciation is based on the actual cost of the asset to the assessee. A divided family member who acquires a specific asset at partition has, in substance, acquired that asset; where the partition valuation is genuine, that value is the cost to the member. The Court relied on Commissioner of Income-tax v. The Buckingham & Carnatic Company, Ltd., Jagat Coal Co. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Indian Iron & Steel Co. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Francis Vallabarayar v. Commissioner of Income-tax, and Commissioner of Income-tax, Burma v. Solomon & Sons, and disapproved the contrary view in Commissioner of Income-tax, U.P. & C.P. v. Seth Mathuradas Mohta.

rule.if: depreciation_claim_after_family_partition and asset_allocated_by_genuine_valuation and assessee_took_over_asset_at_that_valuation and not artificial_valuation

predicates.depreciation_claim_after_family_partitio: The assessee claimed depreciation for an asset received when a joint family was divided.
predicates.asset_allocated_by_genuine_valuation: The asset was allocated using a genuine valuation rather than a merely notional figure.
predicates.assessee_took_over_asset_at_that_valuati: The assessee took over the asset at the valuation used to allocate it, including through an auction among the family members.
predicates.artificial_valuation: The valuation was affected by fraud, collusion, or inflation or deflation for an ulterior purpose.
predicates.depreciation_uses_partition_value: The depreciation calculation uses the genuine value of the asset at which the assessee took it over at partition.

issues.definition: When an assessee claims depreciation for an asset taken over at a genuine valuation in a family partition, and the valuation was not artificial, the depreciation calculation uses that partition value.
